create_InternLM2ForRewardModel: create an InternLM2 reward model with a pretrained config and optional quantization config
run_InternLM2ForRewardModel_forward: run the forward pass of InternLM2ForRewardModel to get reward embeddings from input tokens
load_InternLM2ForRewardModel_weights: load pretrained weights into an InternLM2ForRewardModel from a causal LM checkpoint
build_reward_model_pooler: build a reward model that pools last token hidden states and scores them with a linear head
review_InternLM2ForRewardModel_EntryClas: review the InternLM2ForRewardModel class and its EntryClass export for reward modeling usage
